document.title: Services agreement — website build (demonstration)
document.text:
SERVICES AGREEMENT (demonstration template, fictional parties)
The contractor builds the client's website for $4,000.
The contractor assigns all copyright and all moral rights in the deliverables to the client.
Late payments bear interest at 1.5% per month.
